FIGHTER_POWER_FIGHTING_SPIRIT.title: Fighting Spirit
FIGHTER_POWER_FIGHTING_SPIRIT.descriptio:
Max 6 stacks.
+1 STR +1 DEX while active.
+1 per turn (outside burnout).
FIGHTER_POWER_COMBO.title: Combo
FIGHTER_POWER_COMBO.description:
Max 1 stack.
Enables bonus effects on [gold]Combo[/gold] cards.
FIGHTER_POWER_COMBO.smartDescription: Combo active. Enables combo bonus effects.
FIGHTER_POWER_CANCEL.title: Cancel
FIGHTER_POWER_CANCEL.description:
Max 1 stack.
Next Special or Super card costs 1 less energy.
FIGHTER_POWER_STRIKE_THROW_MIXUP.title: Strike-Throw Mixup
FIGHTER_POWER_STRIKE_THROW_MIXUP.descrip:
Attacks ignore Block.
Throw frame cost -3.
FIGHTER_POWER_TIPSY.title: Tipsy
FIGHTER_POWER_TIPSY.description:
Max 4 stacks.
Enhances the effectiveness of drunken fist cards.
FIGHTER_POWER_WHIFF_PUNISH.title: Whiff Punish
FIGHTER_POWER_WHIFF_PUNISH.description: Counter-hit vs enemies with Attack intent grants +2 extra frames.
FIGHTER_POWER_DEVILS_SONG_POWER.title: Devil's Song
FIGHTER_POWER_DEVILS_SONG_POWER.descript:
Tipsy is treated as 4 (max).
Each attack gains 1 frame.
FIGHTER_POWER_DEVILS_SONG_POWER.smartDes: {Amount} turn(s) remaining. Tipsy treated as max.
FIGHTER_POWER_FIGHTER_INNATE_POWER.title: Fighter's Talent
FIGHTER_POWER_FIGHTER_INNATE_POWER.descr:
Start combat with 6 Fighting Spirit.
+1 STR +1 DEX while Spirit is active.
Regain 1 Spirit per turn.
At 0 Spirit: Burnout (2 Weak + 2 Vulnerable for 2 turns), then refill to 6.
Clear Combo at end of turn.
FIGHTER_POWER_CONFIRM_POWER.title: Confirm
FIGHTER_POWER_CONFIRM_POWER.description: Combo and Cancel cards deal 50% more damage.
FIGHTER_POWER_TC_POWER.title: TC
FIGHTER_POWER_TUNDRA_STORM_POWER.title: Tundra Storm
FIGHTER_POWER_TUNDRA_STORM_POWER.descrip:
Blocked damage heals you and is reflected back to the attacker.
Lasts 1 turn.
FIGHTER_POWER_YI_JIANLIAN_POWER.title: One-Button Chain
FIGHTER_POWER_YI_JIANLIAN_POWER.descript: Cancel cards deal 80% damage but randomly play Cancel cards from your draw pile.
FIGHTER_POWER_YI_JIANLIAN_POWER.smartDes: Cancel cards 80% dmg, random Cancel plays.
FIGHTER_POWER_COUNTER_HIT_POWER.title: Counter Hit
FIGHTER_POWER_COUNTER_HIT_POWER.descript: Next incoming attack deals +20% damage and grants the attacker 2 frames.
FIGHTER_POWER_PUNISH_COUNTER_POWER.title: Punish Counter
FIGHTER_POWER_PUNISH_COUNTER_POWER.descr: Next incoming attack deals +20% damage and grants the attacker 4 frames.
